# verda mcp

> Verda CLI **v1.10.0** · [other versions](https://github.com/verda-cloud/verda-cli/tags)

MCP server for AI agent integration (beta)

[Beta] Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that exposes Verda Cloud
operations as structured tools for AI agents.

Requires valid credentials — run "verda auth login" first.

Subcommands:

- [`verda mcp serve`](#verda-mcp-serve): Start MCP server on stdio

## verda mcp serve

Start MCP server on stdio

Start a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that communicates
over stdin/stdout. Configure in your AI agent:

```text
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "verda": {
      "command": "verda",
      "args": ["mcp", "serve"]
    }
  }
}
```

**Usage**

```text
verda mcp serve [flags]
```

---

Global flags such as `--output`, `--agent` and `--debug` work with every command: see [Global Flags](../commands.md#global-flags).
